description: Get the photos and/or videos inside a Pexels collection by its ID (paginated, optionally filtered to just photos or just videos). Each item is returned in the same compact shape its own domain tool would use, tagged with `media_type`. Read-only. Each photo includes several pre-sized URLs in `src` (original/large2x/large/medium/small/portrait/landscape/tiny) — pick the closest fit rather than always using `original`. `video_files` is trimmed to the highest-resolution renditions (see `video_files_count` for the full count) — call pexels_get_video for the complete rendition list on one video.

per_page.description: Items per page (clamped to a max of 80).

type.description: Filter media by type. Omit to return both photos and videos.

name: pexels_get_collection_media
title: Get Pexels Collection Media
